description: This file defines the AuthProvider class which manages user authentication state, providing methods for login, registration, and logout, and maintains user-related information such as token, userId, and userName.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Manages user authentication state and provides methods for login, registration, and logout.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates user login by setting dummy token and user info; in real implementation, would invoke backend API.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Simulates user registration by setting dummy token and user info; in real implementation, would invoke backend API.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears user authentication data and notifies listeners.
